name: MedHELM
intro: MedHELM提出了可扩展的医学任务评估框架，基于29名临床专家验证的分类体系，覆盖5大类、22个子类和121项任务。其35个基准由17个现有基准、5个重构基准和13个全新基准组成，其中13个全新基准里有12个基于EHR；框架以自动指标或三模型LLM评审团评分，并联合分析胜率与成本。
build_method: 临床专家分类体系, 现有基准映射, 数据重构, EHR任务构建
metric: LLM-as-Judge, Win Rate, Accuracy, Exact Match
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 分类, 生成, 对话
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Classification, Generation, Dialogue
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Human Annotation, LLM Generation
intro_en: MedHELM is a scalable medical-task evaluation framework built on a taxonomy validated by 29 clinicians and covering five categories, 22 subcategories, and 121 tasks. Its 35 benchmarks comprise 17 existing, five reformulated, and 13 new benchmarks, 12 of the 13 new benchmarks using EHR data. It scores tasks with automated metrics or a three-model LLM jury and jointly analyzes normalized win rate and cost.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.23802 and the official Stanford CRFM MedHELM platform. The diagrams preserve the initial five-category, 21-subcategory, 98-task taxonomy; review by 29 clinicians across 14 specialties and four institutions; 96.7% mapping agreement, 4.21/5 comprehensiveness, and 107 comments; the final five-category, 22-subcategory, 121-task taxonomy; 17 existing, five reformulated, and 13 new benchmarks, 12 of the new benchmarks using EHR data; the exact 35-benchmark suite with 13 open-ended and 22 closed-ended tasks and 14 public, seven gated, and 14 private access levels; context, prompt, metric, and optional-gold contracts; uniform evaluation of nine frontier models; exact-match or Micro-F1 closed scoring; the GPT-4o, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, and Llama 3.3 70B jury's nine 1-to-5 ratings; 20-clinician validation on 31 ACI-Bench plus 25 MEDIQA outputs with jury ICC 0.47; and pairwise normalized win rate, 35-benchmark macro-average, and 2025-05-12 cost pricing.
